@ with no condition, or one that always holds, the head reads its input at the frames 0, 2, 4 ...
process 2 frames=12 in c=[true true true true true true true true true true true true]
@ a part that is stopped reads nothing, and the one that runs again reads the value of the frame where its own grid ticks (not the grid of the caller)
process 0 frames=12 in c=[false true true false false true true true false true true true]
@ a slow head input and a slow condition: the first run reads the caller's value of its frame
@ the time that the head reads is the caller's time at its own tick of sample / 2, held and read at the tick of the part's grid
process 1 frames=12 in c=[false true true false false true true true false true true true]
process 2 frames=12 in c=[false true true false false true true true false true true true]
@ the calls of process cut the frames at a tick of the part, in a stopped stretch and at 0 frames, and a reset starts over: the same values (§13.4, §11.6)
process 0 frames=3 in c=[true true false]
process 0 frames=6 in c=[true true false true true true]
process 1 frames=3 in c=[false true true]
process 1 frames=12 in c=[false true true false false true true true false true true true]
